118250.name: Chabad Lubavitch of Cambridge
118250.note: CrownHeights.info, 17 Dec 2023: Rabbi Hirschy Zarchi, 'who together with his wife, Elkie, established Chabad-Lubavitch of Cambridge, Mass., in 1997.'

158118.name: Chabad House at Harvard
158118.note: CrownHeights.info, 17 Dec 2023: Rabbi Hirschy and Elkie Zarchi 'established Chabad-Lubavitch of Cambridge, Mass., in 1997', the Harvard Chabad. Medium: the year is stated for Chabad of Cambridge; Harvard Chabad is the same couple's work from the start.

117631.name: Chabad Center of Sharon
117631.note: CrownHeights.info, 5 Feb 2025: Sharon, Mass., 'where his parents, Rabbi Chaim and Sara Wolosow, have served as Chabad-Lubavitch emissaries since 1980.'

118480.name: Chabad Lubavitch at Chestnut Hill
118480.note: CrownHeights.info, 15 Oct 2026: 'Rabbi Mendy and Grunie Uminer established Chabad of Chestnut Hill in 2001'; 'The Uminers arrived in the Boston area in 2001 with their newborn baby ... starting their Chabad center in their home'. Its 10th anniversary was marked in March 2011 (CrownHeights.info).

1597817.name: Beth Menachem Chabad of Newton
1597817.note: CrownHeights.info, 19 Sept 2011: 'Under the leadership of Rabbi Chaim Prus and his wife Nechama, Beth Menachem Chabad has been serving the Jewish community Newton since 2000, when it opened a Chabad center at 229 Dedham Street'; it then moved up the road to 349 Dedham Street. This listing only went up in 2011.

118490.name: Chabad House at Brandeis
118490.note: The Justice (Brandeis), Sept 2012: 'The original house was started in fall 2001 by Rabbi Peretz and his wife, Chanie'. Medium: a Brandeis timeline is said to give 2004 (not checked).

118620.name: Chabad House
118620.note: When and Where in Boston: 'Chabad House is established. 1979 The organization meets initially at 491 Commonwealth Avenue.' Medium: the entry doesn't name the people; Rabbi Shmuel and Chani Posner have run the Chabad House of Greater Boston in Kenmore Square for decades.
